data.title: Vertex falls on “disappointing” FDA delay on kidney drug review; Vera rises
data.description:
Vertex Pharmaceuticals traded lower on Friday, and rival Vera Therapeutics gained after the U.S. FDA extended its review of the former’s kidney disease drug povetacicept, a decision Leerink Partners identified as “quite disappointing.”

Announcing the revised Feb. 28 target action date issued in connection with its Biologics License Application for povetacicept in IgA nephropathy, Vertex on Wednesday attributed the delay to an information request from the FDA.

The company's stock lost more than 10% after the announcement, its worst intra-day performance since August 2025.

Vera Therapeutics , whose once-weekly injectable branded as Trutakna received the U.S. accelerated approval for IgA nephropathy in July, added ~15% in reaction, recording its best intraday gain since June 2025.

Noting the review extension as “quite disappointing,” Leerink Partners analyst David Risinger, who has an Outperform rating on Vertex , remained hopeful. “We now assume that pove will be approved within the next three months,” Risinger wrote, according to Bloomberg.“Although we cannot predict the FDA label, we are hoping that if blood monitoring is required, it is infrequent and thus does not materially impact commercial prospects,” the analyst added.

Baird analyst Brian Skorney, who has an Underperform rating on Vertex , argued that the delay allows rivals Vera and Otsuka Holdings to extend their lead in the IgAN market with their directly competitive, approved drugs. “In a worst-case scenario, the FDA request is looking closer at potential need for IgG monitoring for povetacicept,” Skorney added.

Raymond James analyst Christopher Raymond argued that the insufficient details provided on the reason for the delay are "likely to fuel bearish speculation around the drug’s safety profile.” Raymond, who has a Market Perform rating on VRTX, says he “can’t argue that this program does not now carry a meaningfully higher level of risk.”

data.title: Bigger Generali stake among options for UniCredit as partnership expands, sources say
data.description:
UniCredit has been weighing a possible increase of its 9% stake in Generali , four people close to the matter said, as Italy's second-biggest bank and the country's largest insurer discuss new commercial accords.

The Generali investment has so far been the only move by UniCredit CEO Andrea Orcel in Italy's fast-consolidating banking market.

The veteran dealmaker has just secured control of Germany's Commerzbank , and says UniCredit will grow its domestic market share without any major acquisitions.

Meanwhile, the Generali stake has positioned UniCredit as a counterweight to its main rival Intesa Sanpaolo - which looks set to become the biggest Generali shareholder through a takeover of Monte dei Paschi di Siena (MPS) .

Two of the four people said UniCredit could raise its Generali holding towards the 13.4% stake which is expected to pass from MPS into Intesa's hands.

The outcome of UniCredit's deliberations remains uncertain.

UniCredit and Generali both declined to comment.

By exercising significant influence over Generali, without control, Intesa can book the insurer's profits in its earnings in proportion to the stake, under international accounting rules.

Independent of its Generali stake coming from the MPS deal, Intesa has also built a further 3% stake in the insurer, which it has said it will dispose of.

Intesa CEO Carlo Messina has said he would be happy for UniCredit and Generali to find ways to generate profits together.

UniCredit first unveiled a 4.1% Generali stake , before building it up to the current 9.05%. Crossing 10% requires supervisory approval.

UniCredit and Generali, which already partner in eastern Europe, have been discussing closer commercial ties.

On November 9, Orcel said it was up to Generali to decide whether to accept UniCredit's help, adding that he hoped an agreement could be reached in the coming months.

He has repeatedly said such partnerships do not require UniCredit to control Generali, or a formal combination.

Orcel last week put the value of closer cooperation between UniCredit and Generali at €1.5-€2.0 billion ($1.6-$2.2 billion), with Generali remaining independent and simply agreeing to "innovative" forms of partnership.

A day later, Generali CEO Philippe Donnet said the insurer agrees with Orcel's view of the value the two companies can generate together.($1 = 0.9136 euros)

data.title: Globalive Plans Canadian Wireless Return as Sector Weighs Its Future Shape — Market Talk
data.description: Canadian mobile carriers might have another player to contend with on the national stage as Globalive founder Anthony Lacavera plans to launch a standalone wireless operator in Canada. The move comes amid debate over whether Quebecor's C$31 billion bid for Telus would shrink the sector from four major competitors back to three. Using Bermuda-based Paradise Mobile's 5G technology, Lacavera is pitching Globalive as a fourth-carrier option in a sector dominated by a handful of communication and media conglomerates. "Any consolidation the government approves must make room for an independent, pure-play wireless carrier," Lacavera says, noting a wireless-only rival can undercut prices without cannibalizing legacy cable or TV bundles. Still, Globalive could face an uphill regulatory battle after Prime Minister Mark Carney suggested earlier this month that fewer players can sometimes still foster competition. (adriano.marchese@wsj.com)

data.title: Romania's consolidated budget deficit at 3.92% of GDP at end-October
data.description:
Key points:
  • Romania's 2026 deficit target 6.2% of output, finmin warns of risks
  • Government must approve 2027 budget by year-end
  • Romanian funding needs will fall to 248 billion lei in 2027

Romania's consolidated budget deficit shrank to 3.92% of economic output in the first 10 months of the year, Finance Minister Alexandru Nazare said on Friday, from a shortfall of 5.64% in the same period of 2025.

Nazare warned that spending commitments in the final two months of the year were rising, and added that Romania must continue cutting its budget shortfall next year to avoid losing its investment-grade credit rating and keep its access to European Union funds.

The country is aiming to lower its budget deficit, the EU's largest, from more than 9% of economic output in 2024 to 6.2% this year and below 3.0% by 2031.

"Romania cannot afford to stop the fiscal consolidation," Nazare told reporters. "The window for an orderly correction is open but narrowing."

The minority government of Prime Minister Luca Niculescu, appointed after a nearly six-month political impasse, must balance deficit cuts against social pressure to raise state wages and pensions after a two-year cap.

Meanwhile, Romania's public debt has exceeded 60% and is expected to keep growing.

In nominal terms, the deficit stood at 81.9 billion lei ($16.85 billion) at the end of October. Revenue totaled 596.32 billion lei, or 28.6% of output.

Nazare said Romania had about 19 billion lei worth of funding obligations for the rest of the year, including 15 billion lei in wage increases for judges and prosecutors which were challenged but upheld in court.

Romania's funding needs will fall to 248 billion lei next year from this year's 279 billion lei, Nazare said, a respite for the ailing economy where the high borrowing requirements and elevated bond yields are pushing corporate borrowing rates towards double digits.

($1 = 4.8597 lei)

data.title: Cryptos Jump Amidst Wall Street's Surge
data.description:
WASHINGTON (dpa-AFX) - A massive positive sentiment in Wall Street helped crypto markets rise emphatically, lifting Bitcoin to a 24-hour high of $62,105. Overall crypto market capitalization has increased 1.2 percent overnight.

Wall Street futures have rallied strongly from the flatline, boosting sentiment for cryptocurrencies. The US Top 30 (DJIA) is trading 1.2 percent higher at 50,791.50. The U.S. Top 500 (S&P 500) is trading 1.5 percent higher at 7,288.80. The U.S. Tech 100 (Nasdaq 100) is trading 2.1 percent higher at 26,594.90.

The CMC Crypto Fear and Greed Index which measures the overall sentiment in the crypto market has increased further in the Extreme Fear category. It is currently at 11, versus 10 a day earlier and 8 a week earlier. The reading had touched a yearly low of 5 on February 6, 2026.

Aggregate crypto liquidations during the 24-hour period stood at $248 million. Liquidation of long positions stood at $79 million, far lower than the liquidation of short positions which amounted to $169 million. Meanwhile the overall cryptocurrency market capitalization has increased 1.2 percent overnight to $2.11 trillion. The jump in market capitalization is however accompanied by a 29-percent drop in trading volumes.

At current prices, 59 of the top 100 cryptocurrencies are trading with overnight gains of more than a percent. On the other hand, 13 are trading with overnight losses of more than a percent.

Bitcoin, the largest cryptocurrency is currently trading 0.91 percent higher on an overnight basis at $61,369.92. Bitcoin is however saddled with losses of 30 percent on a year-to-date basis. Bitcoin traded between $62,105 and $59,879 during the past 24 hours. Bitcoin currently dominates 58.7 percent of the overall crypto market.

Bitcoin Spot ETF products in the U.S. witnessed net outflows jumping to $453 million on Wednesday from $231 million on Tuesday. iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF (IBIT) topped with net outflows of $330 million.

Bitcoin is currently ranked in the 15th position in the global ranking of all assets as per market capitalization published by companiesmarketcap.com. The leading cryptocurrency is currently positioned between 14th ranked Eli Lilly and 16th ranked Berkshire Hathaway.

Bitcoin's surge however contrasts with a 2.9 percent overnight surge in the price of gold futures for December settlement.

Ethereum (ETH) has rallied 1.1 percent overnight to $1,721.67. The leading alternate coin has however lost 42 percent till date in 2026.

Ethereum Spot ETF products in the U.S. witnessed net outflows increasing to $69 million on Wednesday from $64 million on Tuesday. iShares Ethereum Trust ETF (ETHA) accounted for the outflows entirely.

Ethereum has jumped to the 90th position in the global ranking of all assets as per market capitalization published by companiesmarketcap.com.

4th ranked BNB (BNB), the native coin of the BNB Chain ecosystem has surged 1.6 percent to $561.97. Year-to-date losses amount to 35 percent.

6th ranked XRP (XRP), a payments-focused cryptocurrency also added 1.4 percent overnight. XRP has shed 48 percent on a year-to-date basis. XRP is currently trading at $0.9659.

The price of 7th ranked Solana (SOL) jumped 2.5 percent overnight to $73.11. SOL has gained 2.5 percent in the past week. U.S.-listed Solana Spot ETF products witnessed nil inflows on Wednesday versus net inflows of $1 million on Tuesday.

TRON (TRX) ranked 8th overall is currently trading 0.29 percent higher at $0.3045. With gains of 7.1 percent, TRON is the highest-ranking cryptocurrency to trade with year-to-date gains.

9th ranked Hyperliquid (HYPE) jumped 7.6 percent on an overnight basis to $66.00. U.S.-listed Hyperliquid Spot ETF products witnessed net outflows of $2 million on Wednesday as well as Tuesday.

10th ranked Zcash (ZEC) rallied 4.2 percent overnight and the cryptocurrency is currently trading at $752.96. U.S.-listed Zcash Spot ETF products witnessed net outflows of $2 million on Wednesday as compared with nil flows on Tuesday.

data.title: Brazilian stocks surge as Bradesco chairman named finance minister
data.description:
Brazil’s benchmark Ibovespa index (IBOV) jumped 2.6% to hover above 181.5K on Friday, extending a 6.1% rally from the prior session as Bradesco board chairman Luiz Carlos Trabuco was tapped as finance minister.

The Planalto Palace confirmed Thursday night that Trabuco had accepted President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s invitation, validating market speculation that had fueled gains over recent days.

Investors view the banking executive as likely to curb public spending, easing fiscal concerns that have pressured Brazilian equities amid elevated domestic yields and sluggish business activity since Lula’s re-election.

Many Brazilian stocks, especially those within the financials sector, gapped higher on the news, with Bradesco soaring 17% at the time of writing, XP +18%, Sabesp +13%, Itaú Unibanco Holding S.A. +13%, Petróleo Brasileiro S.A. +7%, StoneCo +5%, Companhia Energética de Minas Gerais +12%, PagSeguro Digital +7%, Nu Holdings +8%, Ambev S.A. +8%.

Other Brazilian stocks include: Vale , Banco Santander Brasil , Embraer , Gerdau , Companhia Siderúrgica Nacional (CSN) , Suzano , Braskem , Ultrapar , Copel , Telefônica Brasil (Vivo) , TIM S.A. , BrasilAgro , Inter&Co , PicPay , Agibank , JBS , VTEX , CI&T , Afya , Patria Investments , Vinci Compass , Nuvini (Nvni Group) (NVNI), and Atlas Lithium .

data.title: Alligator Bioscience completes sale of mitazalimab to Biossil
data.description:
Lund, Sweden – 27 November 2026 – Alligator Bioscience (Nasdaq Stockholm: ATORX) today announced that the sale of all rights and assets related to the CD40 agonist antibody mitazalimab to Biossil Inc. (“Biossil”), communicated on 31 October 2026, has been completed.

All significant closing conditions have been satisfied, and ownership of mitazalimab and responsibility for its further development, manufacturing and patent costs have passed to Biossil. Alligator has received the upfront payment of USD 0.75 million, and remains eligible for milestone payments and royalties on future sales, as described in the press release of 31 October 2026.

“We are pleased to have completed this transaction, which represents an important milestone for Alligator. We would like to thank everyone involved for their dedication and professionalism throughout the process,” said Johan Giléus, CFO, and incoming CEO, of Alligator Bioscience.

For further information, please contact:

Johan Giléus, CFO

E-mail: johan.gileus@alligatorbioscience.com

Phone: +46 (0) 46 540 82 00

The information was submitted for publication, through the agency of the contact person set out above, at 3:45 p.m. CET on 27 November 2026.

About Alligator Bioscience

Alligator is a biotechnology company with financial interests, through milestone payments and royalties on future sales, in two programmes: HLX22, an anti-HER2 monoclonal antibody being developed by Shanghai Henlius Biotech Inc., and mitazalimab, an anti-CD40 monoclonal antibody, including its derivatives, being developed by Biossil, Inc. Alligator also holds an interest in the antibody ALG.APV-527, co-developed with Aptevo Therapeutics Inc., as well as in the bispecific antibody format RUBY™.

Alligator is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm (ATORX) and headquartered in Lund, Sweden.

data.title: Oil Futures Mixed in Shortened U.S. Trading Day — Market Talk
data.description: Crude futures are mixed in light U.S. Black Friday trading with the market watching shipping risks in the Middle East and awaiting Sunday's meeting of OPEC and its allies to discuss output policy for 2027. "Long-running tensions within the group may surface over output quota decisions," and disputes among members could weaken the group's pricing power, Hamad Hussain of Capital Economics says in a note. "A more fractious and less cohesive OPEC+ will lead to greater oil price volatility and skew the balance of risks towards lower oil prices over time," he adds. WTI is up 0.5% at $84.09 a barrel and Brent is down 1.2% at $95.42 a barrel ahead of Monday's January contract expiry. (anthony.harrup@wsj.com)

data.title: What was Coinbase worth while Nasdaq was closed?
data.description:
Tokenized stocks give investors another place to trade after the closing bell. Coinbase’s Thanksgiving tape shows why it still matters where else the shares changed hands and how many you want to trade.

On Thanksgiving afternoon, a buyer spent 125.49 USDC (USDC) on tokenized Coinbase shares while Nasdaq was closed. If you’d last checked the stock at Wednesday’s closing bell, that small purchase seemed to carry news of a holiday rally.

Coinbase had closed at $103.72, and the buyer on OKXICE paid 106.24 USDC per token, an apparent gain of 2.4%. But if you’d stayed for Wednesday’s after-hours session, you’d have seen the shares reach $106.91, according to brokerage Public.

From there, the very same token trade looked about 0.6% lower, valuing USDC at a dollar. However, the choice of where to start measuring was enough to turn a gain into a decline.

Related: Nasdaq exec pushes for common EU rules on tokenized securities

An investor in Germany had an even fresher price to go on. Early on Thanksgiving, 142 Coinbase shares changed hands on Tradegate at 97.50 euros apiece, roughly $107 at that day’s exchange rate.

What changed for the afternoon buyer was that they could open a wallet and buy Coinbase exposure over the holiday, and anyone following the stock could see exactly what that order cost.

Finding oneself on the other side of that trade with $10,000 worth of Coinbase to sell, the blockchain could tell you to four decimal places what someone had paid for just over one token, but could you get that price for 94?

Sign up for Cointelegraph’s Daybreak newsletter to read more...

data.title: Mahanadi Coalfields shares make muted debut on stock exchanges
data.description:
Shares of Mahanadi Coalfields, the largest coal producing subsidiary of State-run coal behemoth Coal India, on Friday made a muted debut on stock exchanges and ended with a discount of nearly 3 per cent against the issue price of ₹136.

On the NSE, the stock made its debut at ₹134, registering a discount of 1.47 per cent. It ended at ₹132.50 apiece, around 2.57 per cent below the issue price.

On the BSE, the shares closed at ₹132.60 apiece, down 2.5 per cent from the issue price and 0.41 per cent below the opening price of ₹133.15. During the day, the stock hit the day’s low of ₹130.70, lower by 3.89 per cent.

Market valuation of Mahanadi Coalfields (MCL), which is the single largest coal producing firm in India in terms of production in FY26, stood at ₹87,759.49 crore.

“The (investors’) response to IPO indicates (they) may not be that gung-ho about Coal India or its subsidiaries that are into conventional coal production,” said Arun Kejriwal, founder at Kejriwal Research & Investment Services.

Cholamandalam Securities said in a note last week that Mahanadi Coalfields faces structural challenges from the gradual transition towards renewable energy.

The initial public offering (IPO) of MCL was subscribed 1.52 times on the final day of bidding on Monday. The issue received bids of 74,86,87,060 equity shares against the offered 49,30,68,045 equity shares.

MCL is the third Coal India subsidiary to tap the public markets this year. Coal India has already listed Bharat Coking Coal Ltd in January, while the IPO of Central Mine Planning & Design Institute Ltd concluded in March.

“Mahanadi Coalfields Limited has been listed on BSE Ltd and National Stock Exchange of India Ltd effective November 27, 2026. As a result, the company’s shareholding in Mahanadi Coalfields stands reduced from 100 per cent to 90 per cent of the issued and paid-up equity share capital of Mahanadi Coalfields Limited,” Coal India said in a stock exchange filing.

“Consequent to the above, Mahanadi Coalfields ceases to be a wholly owned subsidiary of the company. However, it continues to remain a subsidiary of the company,” CIL added.

Incorporated in 1992, MCL produced 218.31 million tonnes of coal in FY26, accounting for around 22.4 per cent of India’s total non-coking coal production.
